class.name: GameplayDebugger
class.brief_description: The gameplay debugger's category registry. Engine singleton.
class.description: Exists on every machine, dedicated servers included, because categories collect their data on the server. The built-in categories come first - [GameplayDebuggerCategoryBasic], [GameplayDebuggerCategoryAbilities], [GameplayDebuggerCategoryMovement], [GameplayDebuggerCategoryNet] - then the scripts listed in [code]application/game_framework/debug/gameplay_debugger_categories[/code], in order. A category's slot (its numpad key in the [GameplayDebuggerHUD]) is its index in that list.

method.name: collect
method.description: Runs each named category's [method GameplayDebuggerCategory.collect_data] for [param target]. Keyed by category name, plus [code]_target_found[/code].

method.name: get_category
method.description: The category of that name, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_category_names
method.description: Every category name, in slot order.

method.name: register_category
method.description: Adds a category, or replaces the one with the same name.
